checks: Consecutive event IDs and ordered ticks
Every household's pre-state equals its preceding post-state
All 2000 inferred initial household states match setup totals
Original transition margins match adjacent aggregate states
Revised event net flows match adjacent aggregate states at every week
All revised status-changing events agree with successful event totals
limits: One seed-42 realization with several model changes combined; differences do not identify individual mechanism effects.
Adjacent-week status changes include access and forced losses, not only voluntary provider switching.
Original data do not identify corresponding voluntary/forced event counts; absent original categories must not be plotted as zero.
Statuses f/i/n omit changes between informal service drops and hook-ons.
Lower churn is an outcome difference, not evidence of improved empirical realism or household welfare.
